definition: The recipient can use the money. The customer sees a completed payment.
evidence: beneficiary_credit_confirmed event received from the partner bank

definition: The partner bank returned a completed-settlement status for the payment instruction.
evidence: Status code ACSC in the partner bank's status message

definition: The payment is posted to the general ledger and matched to a line on the bank's end-of-day statement.
evidence: camt.053 statement entry matched to a ledger posting

definition: A person or business with a login to the app. Verified or not.
A person or legal entity that finished identity checks and holds an approved onboarding record.
evidence: Onboarding case closed with outcome approved

definition: The legal entity that receives invoices and owes fees. One entity can own many accounts.
evidence: Billing account record with a tax ID

definition: Sanctions screening returned no match or every match was reviewed and dismissed.
evidence: Screening case closed with result clear

definition: The instruction passed schema and business-rule validation and can enter the processing queue.
A person reviewed a held payment and released it for sending.
evidence: Hold released event carrying a reviewer ID

definition: The customer logged in or sent a payment in the last 30 days.
The customer is not suspended and the identity record is current.
evidence: kyc_status is current and account_status is not suspended

definition: The customer holds funds or owes fees. The account stays in monthly reporting.
